S.walked: {note}: {days} days on the road; it is now day {day}.
S.stamp_event: On the road from {a} to {b}, day {d} (now day {{day}}): {text}. Not at {b} yet; no arriving until this is settled.
S.stop_fresh: On day {d}: {text}; {b} is out of reach this turn. The party is on the road now (the engine placed it at {road}, not at the gate). Rewrite lines up to this moment (write the first {before} days as usual), no arrival; no move in ops (moving back to the gate means turning back); the player answers next turn
S.stop_blocked: The road is not settled: day {d}, {text}. {b} is out of reach this turn: write the player's response; a fight is [combat], anything else [referee response]; no move_to {to}
S.resolve_left: ; the party can go on, {left} days left to {b}
S.resolve_today: ; the party can go on and reach {b} today
S.back: Turned back: {n} days to {a}; it is now day {{day}}.
S.finish_left: After the road was settled, {n} more days to {b}; it is now day {{day}}.
S.hint_back: ; to turn back write move player {a_id} (back to {a}, {d} days)
S.hint_pending: - On the road to {to} ({b}), day {d}/{days}, {text} (unsettled): {b} is out of reach this turn; you rule it: if either side fights → [combat name×count]what each one does this beat[/combat], the combat layer settles this round; paying / detour / talking → [referee the player's response], write by the ruling and put the outcome in ops; no move_to {to} until this is settled
S.hint_settled: - On the road to {to} ({b}), day {d}/{days}, the road is settled, {left} days left: write move player {to} to finish the journey (the engine moves the calendar)
S.overshoot: The party was stopped on day {d} ({text}) but the prose went on to day {over}. Write only up to day {d}; the later days have not happened; do not reach {b}
S.travel_head: ## Travel (the map rules where this turn can reach)
S.hint_dungeon: - To {id} ({name}): {how}; write move player {id} to land at the entrance {entry} ({entry_id}); {theme}; danger {danger}
S.days_engine: about {n} days (the engine moves the calendar; write the days on the road in lines; never set time.day yourself)
S.road_ruled: ; whether anything happens on the way is the engine's call (it may stop the party halfway); never invent an encounter
S.hint_enter: - To {id} ({name}): you can enter this turn, landing at {at}
S.hint_clamp: - To {id} ({name}): {why}; write move_to {id}, the engine lands at {at}; the prose stops there, no arrival
S.road_done: the road is already behind you
S.companion_on_road: {who} is still on the road with the player, not at {to}
S.follow_party: on the road, one can only go with the party
S.soul_set_out: {who} sets out from {a} for {b}: {n} days on the road, only the road this beat
S.soul_on_road: {who} is still on the road to {b}, {n} days to go
S.soul_no_place: {a} has no "{to}"; {who} is in {a} and can only go to places in {a}
S.soul_no_road: No road between {a} and {b}; {who} cannot go
S.no_turn_back_now: just stopped on the road: no going back to town this turn; lines end at the stop, no move in ops; turning back can wait for the next turn
S.road_only: on the road to {b}: only on to {to} or back to {from_}
S.not_adjacent: {name} is not next to this room; go through the adjacent rooms first
S.state_rule: Each round: initiative or a hit is [dice {hit}+mod vs target DEF]reason[/dice]; the engine returns the number and pass/fail; damage has no vs: [dice {dmg}+mod]damage[/dice]; a hit must be followed by its damage die, then foe.<id>.hp -N (or player.hp -N) in ops; hp changes only through ops — a wound in the prose without an op did not happen; a fallen foe is foe.<id>.hp -remaining; write this round only: when every foe is down or has fled, the engine itself ends the fight
S.ref_need_q: [referee question] must say what to rule on
S.ref_json: Output one JSON object only: ruling_type / action / ruling / check{{type, attribute (one of STR|DEX|INT|VIT|CHA), difficulty (one of {tiers}) or dc, situation_mod (integer, optional)}} / consequences{{on_success,on_fail}} / narrative_hint. No formulas, no numbers, no modifiers of your own: the engine computes them from the character sheet and the difficulty table; you give the type, attribute, difficulty and situational modifier.
S.ref_no_json: the referee gave no JSON ruling
S.und_head: # This turn, understood (engine, from the world's facts)
S.und_attempt: The player attempts: {said} (an attempt; the outcome is not decided)
S.und_town_only: - {name}: somewhere in {where}; nobody knows where exactly — ask around or go there
S.und_absent: - {name}: not here ({why}). Do not make it appear; if the player goes at it, write the miss or the bystanders' reaction
S.und_sheet: - The player is checking their own stats / pack: the engine has already shown them the panel. Do not list numbers, read out inventories or write system text; at most a line or two of them looking themselves over
S.price_head: ## Prices in this town (in {unit}; quote these, a payment is {var} -N; not enough money, no sale)
S.und_absent_why: no stop on the road, no encounter here
S.no_grounds: There is nobody to fight here ({who}): no road stop, no encounter in this room, nobody like that present. If the player goes at something that is not there, write the miss or the bystanders' reaction; to fight someone who is present, write [referee what the player does to whom] first
S.map_settled: the road is settled; you can go on
S.map_back_fwd: back: {d} days to {a}; ahead: {left} days left
S.set_out: set out: stopped on the road to {b}
S.hint_on_road: ; on the way, or at the door and not yet in: write move player {rid} to stop on the road
